correctness.rationale: The exact AG(2,3) incidence model removes the x+y=c parallel class, leaving nine points and nine degree-three line vertices. Every LTD code requires a,b>=3; when either part has three selections, collision of open signatures forces >=6 on the other part, so size>=8. Four-point covers are W plus p, and four-line covers a whole retained parallel class D plus ell; signature compatibility forces ell through q=W intersect E where E is the D-line through p. All such choices satisfy total domination and unique open signatures. They number 3*3*3*2*2=108. A legal token jump fixes (W,D,E) and flips p or ell, giving 27 C4; token slides are impossible between same-type replaced vertices of a bipartite incidence graph. Fresh independent enumeration over all selected subsets through size 8 corroborated 108 minima and TJ degree 2/TS degree 0; the universal structural proof is not inferred from enumeration.
